name: Vespersteel Archive
image_style: Cinematic gouache-and-ink illustration with dry-brush texture, restrained medieval manuscript detailing, moonlit stone surfaces, and subtle halftone grain. Use a strange, original palette of smoked plum, oxidized teal, tarnished saffron, bone white, and ember red; keep shadows velvety and colors slightly desaturated except for small heraldic accents. The mood is solemn, curious, chivalric, and quietly comic, with historically grounded medieval architecture and clothing rendered reverently. Compose as a spacious 16:10 landscape with a calm, dark upper edge and an uncluttered lower-left region for desktop widgets. No lettering, UI, logos, watermark, or frame.
scene: A moonlit Crusader-era monastery courtyard in the Levant, viewed across worn limestone paving toward a quiet cloister and distant fortified hills. A small medieval astrolabe rests on a stone table in the calm lower-left foreground, while a few historically accurate monks and armored pilgrims study the night sky with respectful seriousness. Space Ghost stands awkwardly but politely at the far right beside a rain barrel, muscular white costume immaculate, black hood and mask, yellow cape gathered against the breeze, red power bands visible; he is holding an oversized brass astrolabe as if conducting an important military inspection, clearly out of place but not mocking the sacred setting. A shuttered chapel and simple wooden cross appear in the background with genuine reverence, never as props or punchlines. Quiet upper sky, subtle crescent moon, long blue-plum shadows, understated affectionate humor, no text.
